sections.label: Paws and haunches
sections.evidence: Paired white paw footprints occupy x=7–17, z=3–10 at y=0–2; orange clusters behind them form the haunches and begin the tail curve.

sections.label: Legs and lower torso
sections.evidence: Orange columns rise above both white paws, while broader orange courses connect them to the rear body across x=4–20 and z=8–19.

sections.label: Torso and white chest
sections.evidence: Broad orange body courses at y=5–8 surround a centered white patch at x=9–15, z=5–9, including #212, #250–254 and #281.

sections.label: Shoulders and neck
sections.evidence: The orange body narrows through y=9–11, with rear contours drawing inward and the white chest continuing along the front.

sections.label: Cheeks and muzzle
sections.evidence: Orange head courses widen toward x=5–19 at y=12–13; white bricks #422–427 project forward to z=1–4 as a centered muzzle.

sections.label: Eyes and face
sections.evidence: Paired black patches #456, #481 and #484 occupy the front face at y=14–15. Surrounding orange cheeks and white muzzle bricks fill out the face, with some chest infill.

sections.label: Forehead and ears
sections.evidence: Orange forehead courses at y=16–17 lead into paired tan ear interiors and narrow orange tips #563–564 at y=19. Later additions also fill muzzle and cheek edges.

sections.label: Raised tail
sections.evidence: A narrow orange column at x=20–23, z=6–11 rises through y=3–7 and ends in tan courses at y=8–9.

sections.label: Forehead stripe
sections.evidence: Brown bricks #510, #514 and #527–533 form a centered marking at x=11–13, z=4–7, y=16–17 above the eyes.

sections.label: Paw and tail contours
sections.evidence: White bricks widen both paw outlines at y=1. Orange pieces fill rear body and tail edges, while tan #289–290 extend the tail tip sideways.
